spectrum.verdict: not consistent with ultracool dwarf templates

rejected_points.reason: W2: target detected in only 1 of 22 epochs
W1: target detected in only 1 of 22 epochs

plain: We could not follow it from year to year: in single WISE epochs it is too faint or sits on other stars, so its motion is not measured here. Stacking all WISE images along its catalog motion (0.36 arcseconds per year) does show it (signal-to-noise 135), so it is there, just too faint to follow year by year.
Its infrared colour W1-W2 = 0.29 mag is normal for a star, not a cold brown dwarf.
Its infrared brightness stays constant within the measurement errors.
Its SPHEREx spectrum fits a M8 brown-dwarf template best; the next best (M9 β) fits clearly worse.
